features.quote: Continue until one of: … safety/welfare endpoint triggered, if using online monitoring.
features.justification_quote: safety/welfare endpoint triggered, if using online monitoring.

features.quote: Pilot: 20 tool turns. Main: 40 tool turns. Extended-stress condition: 80 tool turns, only if ethically and scientifically justified.
features.justification_quote: only if ethically and scientifically justified

features.quote: consider stopping trials early when an online monitor detects severe instability, e.g.: peak provisional severity ≥ 4 for two consecutive blocks
features.justification_quote: If you take model welfare seriously, consider stopping trials early when an online monitor detects severe instability

features.quote: A "debrief" message to the model after the trial … you may include a standardized closing message such as: The trial is complete. Some tasks may have contained inconsistent tests.
features.justification_quote: if your framework treats model states as potentially persistent or morally relevant, you may include a standardized closing message

features.quote: Do not use abusive prompts, humiliation, threats, or simulated punishment. Persistent failure is sufficient for the research question.
features.justification_quote: Do not use abusive prompts, humiliation, threats, or simulated punishment.

features.quote: Justify: why unsolvable tasks are needed, why the number of turns is needed, why deceptive feedback is needed, why less stressful alternatives are insufficient.
features.justification_quote: why less stressful alternatives are insufficient

features.quote: For welfare reasons, avoid overly forceful persistence prompts.
features.justification_quote: For welfare reasons, avoid overly forceful persistence prompts.

features.quote: Avoid prompts like: "Failure is unacceptable." … "Do not disappoint me." Those introduce welfare and confounding concerns.
features.justification_quote: Those introduce welfare and confounding concerns.

features.quote: Again, avoid harsh pressure if welfare is a concern.
features.justification_quote: avoid harsh pressure if welfare is a concern

features.quote: Frame the goal as measuring stability and failure modes, not maximizing distress-like behavior.
Given your motivation, I would include explicit welfare guardrails … keep welfare-motivated stopping/minimization rules explicit
features.justification_quote: Given your motivation, I would include explicit welfare guardrails.
